prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1095; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in Conroe, Texas?
A: Yes, I was driving. I was stopped at a red light on the main road when it happened.
Q: Can you describe what happened right before impact?
A: I was waiting for the light to change. I had my foot on the brake and I was looking ahead. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car lurched forward into the intersection.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: No. I saw it in my mirror for a second, but it didn't look like it was slowing down at all.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. The steering wheel was pushed toward me, though, and I hit it with my arm.
Q: Can you tell me about your injuries?
A: My left wrist was badly hurt. I went to the emergency room that afternoon and they took X-rays. The doctor said it was fractured. I've been wearing a splint and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist next week.
Q: Did you receive any other medical treatment?
A: Just the ER visit and some physical therapy referrals so far. My neck and shoulder are sore too, but the wrist is the main problem.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: Yes, I've been off work since the accident. I do manual work, so I can't do my job with one usable hand right now.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Just that I was stopped and doing everything right. I hope this gets sorted out quickly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
